_about.what: Parashara's Light 7.0.1 '1001 Yogas' database (Lang1/Yogas_1.dat), decoded. Conditions are PL's own formula strings, parsed with a mirror of PL7.exe's evaluator. See pl_yogas.md for the grammar.
_about.record_layout: 1001 fixed records of 1340 bytes: description text (definition paragraph, blank line, results) at +0 (NUL-terminated, <= 813 bytes); u16 sequence number at +813; formula at +819 (NUL-terminated); name at +1119 (NUL-terminated). Remaining bytes are uninitialised memory.
_about.polarity: From the formula suffix: '~m' = mixed (partly positive), '~n' = negative, none = positive. PL's Yoga Options (all / positive or partly positive / only positive) filter on this.
_about.evaluation: Rashi (D1) chart unless an atom carries a varga prefix (N/S = D9 etc.). Natural benefic/malefic unless the 1001-Yogas screen option "Use functional mal/ben" is on.
_about.condition_tree: op 'and_low' = PL's '**' (lowest precedence AND, split at the first '**' only); 'or' = '+'; 'and' = '*' (binds tighter than '+'). Leaves are atoms.
_about.text_note: definition = first paragraph of PL text (the yoga rule); result_summary = first sentence of PL result text only.
